title: Sunday · the logging road, October 2013
logline: The logging road in October, the maples yellow in the cut, the Legacy pulled over, a man walking up it alone in the middle tier — the dog too old for the climb — and the gate at the top with its chain.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a gravel logging road climbing through a clear-cut with yellow maples at its edges, a station wagon pulled over below.

image.prompt: a gravel logging road climbing through a clear-cut with yellow maples at its edges and a faded green station wagon pulled over at the bottom, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Cut

panels.composition: Tier 2: a man walking up the road alone, hands in his coat, no dog.

image.prompt: a man walking up a gravel logging road alone with his hands in his coat pockets and no dog, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Alone

panels.composition: Tier 3: the gate at the top with its chain and padlock, the ridge beyond, the man stopped at it.

image.prompt: a man stopped at a chained and padlocked steel gate at the top of a logging road with a wooded ridge beyond, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Gate

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: No dog on the climb. Fourteen.
